 async def test_navigation_resume_attests_baseline_and_reconciled_live_page() -> None:
     validations = await _navigation_resume_validations()
 
     assert validations == (_SERVICE_VALIDATION,), (
         "resume must bind the persisted baseline to the reconciled live page"
     )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_graph_pause_reconciles_before_validated_navigation_resume(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+) -> None:
+    page = MagicMock(spec=Page)
+    resume = RecordingOperatorResume([])
+    reconciler = RecordingReconciler([], page_signature="signature-after-pause")
+    harness = await interactive_service_harness(
+        InteractiveHarnessOptions(
+            viewer_page=page,
+            reconciler=reconciler,
+            resume_operator=resume,
+        )
+    )
+    await harness.service.create_interactive_lease(
+        harness.lease_request, process_owner=OWNER
+    )
+    await harness.service.release_interactive_lease(
+        harness.release_request, process_owner=OWNER
+    )
+    baseline = await harness.host.registry.get_session(harness.invocation.access)
+    context = replace(
+        _SERVICE_CONTEXT,
+        generation=int(baseline.generation),
+        page_signature="signature-before-pause",
+        takeover_available=True,
+    )
+    record = harness.manager.interrupt_records[RUN_ID]["control"]
+    record.suggested_value = context.to_json()
+    record.interrupt_type = "navigation"
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        "cloud.services.browser_sessions.navigation_resume.navigation_step_signature",
+        AsyncMock(return_value=context.page_signature),
+    )
+
+    await harness.service.prepare_operator_pause(RUN_ID)
+    ready = await harness.host.registry.get_session(harness.invocation.access)
+    grant = await harness.service.create_interactive_lease(
+        harness.lease_request.model_copy(update={"generation": ready.generation}),
+        process_owner=OWNER,
+    )
+    await harness.service.resume_browser_automation(
+        harness.release_request.model_copy(
+            update={
+                "checkpoint": grant.session.checkpoint,
+                "generation": grant.session.generation,
+            }
+        ),
+        process_owner=OWNER,
+    )
+
+    assert (baseline.state, ready.state, ready.generation) == (
+        BrowserSessionState.CONTROLLED,
+        BrowserSessionState.READY,
+        baseline.generation + 1,
+    )
+    assert resume.validations == (
+        [replace(_SERVICE_VALIDATION, expected_generation=int(baseline.generation))]
+    )
